name: Princess Memory - True Typing
original_name: プリンセスメモリー・トゥルータイピング
source:
The after-story includes three modes:
1. "Quest mode" is a short ADV story.
2. "Battle mode" to fight monsters at an arena
3. "Quiz mode" typing answers to quizzes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
后日谈包含三种模式：1.“任务模式”——一段简短的ADV故事。2.“战斗模式”——在竞技场中与怪物战斗。3.“问答模式”——输入打字回答问题。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
